messages:
nora - design: dropped a small set of mocks for the bulk-rotate UX and the keys list empty-state. looking for quick feedback on copy, keyboard order, and the bulk-preview modal. figma: https://figma.com/file/bulkrotate123

lee - eng: nice patterns. two quick constraints: bulk rotate is async and we only expose a dry-run preview for up to 50 keys. need the UI to state the limit.

jena - ux: agree, surface the 50-key preview limit inline: 'Preview available for first 50 keys'. also show a CSV download option for larger exports.

marc - product: copy note: bulk actions are scary. suggest a short lead paragraph in the modal: 'Bulk rotate will schedule new keys for selected credentials. Old keys will remain valid for their undo window unless you choose immediate revoke.' keeps expectations clear.

nora - design: will add that line. for the scheduling options we have immediate / in 1h / custom. should the CTA read 'Rotate now' vs 'Schedule rotations'?

jena - ux: make the CTA contextual: 'Rotate keys now' for immediate, 'Schedule rotations' for delayed. reduces ambiguity. also add a small inline summary of how many clients might be impacted (estimate) from telemetry.

sasha - support: estimating impacted clients is great. make sure we provide a note: 'Estimate based on last 30d usage; may be incomplete.' avoids blaming us for inaccuracies.

lee - eng: accessibility: bulk-preview table must support keyboard-only row selection and aria-sort for the columns. Also the 'select all' should be tri-state: none/partial/all and announce counts via aria-live when changed.

jena - ux: add a compact status pill on each row: Active / Recently used / Last used 30d. keep color + icon but ensure color blindness safe shapes. nora, can you use both color and icon?

nora - design: yep will add icons. another accessibility nit: the modal has a 'Reason (optional)' textarea. screen readers should focus the error message if validation fails. use aria-invalid and aria-describedby.

marc - product: what about permission flows? bulk rotate should only be allowed for people with key.manage on at least 80% of selected keys. if not, show a preflight list of keys they lack permission for and a single-request button to ask the owning team.

sasha - support: request button is helpful. prefill with suggested text: 'Request rotating these keys on behalf of team X; reason: security refresh.' Also include a link to escalate to org-admins.

lee - eng: API examples please — include both single and bulk endpoints. snippet idea:

```
POST /v1/keys/bulk_rotate
{ "key_ids": ["k_...", "k_..."], "schedule_at": "2026-04-02T08:00:00Z", "dry_run": true }
```

jena - ux: for empty-state of keys list, let's try a less generic message: 'No credentials yet — create an API key to connect services. Need help setting rotation? Try the quick policy setup.' with two CTAs: 'Create API key' and 'Set rotation policy'. keep checklist collapsed.

nora - design: will add a small inline GIF showing the quick policy setup in 3 steps for new users. keep it low-motion and pause on reduced-motion settings.

lee - eng: localization note: the scheduling dropdown shows '1h' and '24h' shorthand. these should localize to full strings in i18n bundles (e.g., '1 hour', '24 hours') to avoid confusion in non-English locales.

jena - ux: good catch. also ensure timezone formatting shows both local timezone and UTC in the schedule preview: 'Scheduled for 2026-04-02 09:00 (PDT) / 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC'.

marc - product: legal/compliance: add a small line in the modal footer when enterprise orgs are selected: 'This action will be logged to your audit trail.' that helps SLAs.

sasha - support: final ask: include a help link in the success screen pointing to 'What to do after rotation' with step-by-step checklist for client updates. reduces churn.

nora - design: all good. i'll iterate and push v2 tonight. tagging accessibility for a quick pass tomorrow morning. :sparkles:
